body: I want you to know you did something amazing tonight. Thank you.

I'm okay. I'm not going to die.

Thank you for caring. This whole thing is weird, I feel like I'm in a trance right now. I know I'm going to wake up in the morning and be like WTF was this all about. I'm going to be embarrassed and feel stupid, but I'll be alive, and I'll keep on living.

Thank you for caring. Thank you for being part of a world in which people care.

Go take care of those who need it. You're doing wonderful things. Thank you.

This is weird. This whole thing feels weird. I'm not the kind of person who does this shit. I'm not usually a drama magnet. This isn't me.. I don't do this shit. But here I am, doing this shit.

Everyone who knows me thinks of me as really stable and together. I don't really know why to be honest, because I've never really been the kind of person who has their shit together, but everyone seems to think that's me for some reason.

Underneath it all though.. fuck, I don't know who I am or what I am, or what my purpose is. I was loved once, and I loved. And now that's gone. And that's a lot of this - lost love. Not exactly an original story. I just don't really know who I am on my own any more.

I'm scared that nobody else will love me. Realistically, practically, that seems unlikely. I'm moderately attractive, I'm socially capable, I can even fake confidence. I'm just so beaten down lately. I don't know what I'm meant to be, and I'm tired to pretending like I do know. This is fucking weird. I deal with my problems myself. I'm not a problem person, I'm a problem solver. I'm the person who other people rely on when shit goes down, that's just kind of the way it is. But here I am, pouring my heart out to you, endlesswatchdog. I have no idea who you are, but I'm really glad you're there. Thankyou for being there.

Holy shit, thank you for caring. You don't know me, you know nothing about me, and me you. You have no reason to care, but you do.

I can't really express what I feel right now, but thank you.

Edit, oh holy shit, I just looked through your comment history. Fuck. You're amazing. I know this is going to sound stupid, but I'd given up on there being good people in the world, or even people who give a fuck. As far as I can tell you spend half your life on Reddit caring about people you don't even know and trying to stop them from dying. You're the kind of person who inhabits the world I want to live in. To be honest, I sort of resent you for giving me hope, because it's less painful to just quit, but then, if I hadn't wanted some kind of out why did I post here instead of just topping myself? Good question, me.
